name: ATC facilities and frequencies (FAA NASR + OurAirports)
description: Every US airport, heliport and seaplane base with a published VHF frequency (tower, ground, clearance, approach/departure, ATIS, CTAF, UNICOM, automated weather) with tower type, hours, radio call and approach provider, plus the FAA ARTCC remote (RCAG) sites that carry en-route Center frequencies; airports worldwide with published frequencies from OurAirports. UHF military frequencies are omitted.
license_note: FAA NASR 28-day subscription data is US Government public data (effective 2026-09-03: APT_BASE.csv, ATC_BASE.csv, FRQ.csv). OurAirports airports.csv and airport-frequencies.csv are released to the public domain. Live audio is never bundled or relayed: LiveATC.net's terms forbid third-party use of its streams, so the layer opens LiveATC's own airport page, or tunes a public web SDR.
build: scripts note: built by a one-off Python pass over the NASR CSV extracts and the OurAirports CSVs (see the layer README in src/layers/atc/policy.js); rebuild each NASR cycle.
